answer: Give each identity one unbranchable thread of public actions. A newcomer starts at an island checkpoint and completes seven steps in fixed order, 48 hours apart, each confirmed before the next opens. A raven marker is earned only after the full 21-day thread, with 50 POA bonded per step and slashing for a false step, such as a false plume report faking presence. One person cannot run ten threads in parallel: steps need fresh attention and gaps cannot be skipped, so each fake costs 21 days plus 350 POA at risk. Limits: attackers can hire labour, so spot re-checks and pauses must remain.
